title: Curve Lengthening Bifurcations in Modally Filtered Nonlinear Schrödinger Systems
summary: Extensions of the parametric nonlinear Schrödinger equations (PNLS) for phase-sensitive optical resonance are developed that preserve the curve lengthening bifurcation seen in the original system. This bifurcation occurs in sharp interface reductions when the motion of the interface transitions from curvature-driven flow (curve shortening) to motion against curvature regularized by higher order Willmore effects (curve lengthening).
